definition: Dialogflow is a natural language understanding platform used to design and integrate a conversational user interface into mobile apps, web applications, devices, bots, interactive voice response systems and related uses.
details: Dialogflow is a natural language understanding platform used to design and integrate a conversational user interface into mobile apps, web applications, devices, bots, interactive voice response systems and related uses.

explainer.lead: Dialogflow is a platform for adding natural-language conversation to software and devices. It helps builders create interfaces that people can interact with through apps, bots, and voice-response systems.

tiers.eli5: Dialogflow is like an interpreter between a person and a computer. Instead of making someone press lots of buttons, it helps an app or device offer a conversation. Builders can use it in things like mobile apps, websites, and telephone answering systems.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use Dialogflow as the natural-language understanding layer when designing and integrating a conversational interface. The same platform can serve mobile and web applications, bots, devices, and interactive voice response systems. It supplies the conversational layer rather than replacing the application or device it connects to.
tiers.paperLevel: Dialogflow is a natural language understanding platform for designing and integrating conversational user interfaces. Its stated application domain is mobile apps, web applications, devices, bots, interactive voice response systems, and related uses. It is therefore an integration platform for conversational interaction, not a standalone end-user application.

explainer.example: A company adds a conversational interface to its mobile app so a customer can ask about an order. Dialogflow provides the natural-language understanding layer, while the mobile app presents the conversation and the company's response.

usedIn.name: Mobile applications
usedIn.detail: Adds a conversational user interface to an app.

usedIn.name: Web applications
usedIn.detail: Integrates natural-language conversation into a web product.

usedIn.name: Bots
usedIn.detail: Provides a platform for designing bot conversations.

usedIn.name: Interactive voice response
usedIn.detail: Supports conversational interfaces in voice-response systems.

explainer.intuition: A conversational interface needs a way to work with natural language before the surrounding product can respond. Dialogflow provides the platform for designing that language-based interaction and integrating it into the product.
howItWorks: Choose the app, device, bot, or voice system that needs a conversational interface.
Design the conversation using Dialogflow's natural-language understanding platform.
Integrate Dialogflow with the target product.
Let users interact with that product through the conversational interface.
explainer.whyItMatters: It gives builders one platform for bringing conversational interaction to several kinds of products, from apps and bots to devices and telephone voice systems.
misconceptions: Dialogflow is not the complete mobile app, website, bot, or device; it supplies the conversational layer integrated into it.
It is not limited to chatbots: its stated uses also include apps, devices, and interactive voice response systems.

nodes.label: Conversational interface
